sources.use: Three audiovisual fields, [Shot 1], stable speaker ID and tagged spoken text; reused verified local guide.

archive-discovery.changes: Replace hidden data chip/scalpel with a brass key beneath loose endpaper; define one archivist, sustained medium framing, fifteen-second discovery/reaction and a short original whispered line.

lunar-flower-walk.changes: Retain the lunar crystalline-flower setting as inspiration; add a teal-coated solitary traveler, side tracking, one visible opening blossom, continuous footprints, a held ending and original sound design.

selection: Two contrasting single-shot narratives selected before generation; no output-based prompt or seed selection and no source-author endorsement.
